page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with 2 physical cores, 2 vCPUs, and 1 thread per core. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests score 1161.28 and 2371.48 respectively, falling into the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 187.49 GB/sec, but large block read-only bandwidth drops to 22.38 GB/sec, which is in the bottom 10%. Geekbench scores reflect similar trends, with a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and lower-tier benchmark results, this instance is designed for workloads with low baseline CPU utilization that require occasional bursts. It is appropriate for lightweight applications such as basic web serving, development environments, and small-scale testing. The lack of local storage and low memory bandwidth make it less appropriate for data-intensive or sustained high-performance computing.
